verified_facts.text: Velaa Private Island is in Noonu Atoll in the Maldives.
verified_facts.excerpt:
P.O. BOX 2071

Noonu Atoll

Republic of Maldives

verified_facts.text: From Velana International Airport in Male, the island is reached by a 45-minute seaplane ride, on Velaa's own plane by private charter or on a commercial seaplane.
verified_facts.excerpt: The island of Velaa is reachable by a scenic seaplane ride of 45 minutes either by Velaa’s customised plane on a private charter (9 seater) or on a commercial seaplane (15 seater).

verified_facts.text: Guests are met on arrival by a Velaa airport butler and escorted to a private lounge before the seaplane transfer.
verified_facts.excerpt: All guests are greeted upon arrival by a Velaa airport butler and directly escorted to the private lounge, with refreshment facilities and a place to rest before the seaplane transfer.

verified_facts.text: Private jets can land at Maafaru International Airport, a 7-minute seaplane or 35-minute yacht ride from Velaa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private jets can comfortably land at Maafaru International Airport, with just a 7-minute seaplane distance or a relaxed 35-minute luxury yacht ride from Velaa.

verified_facts.text: The Velaa Golf Academy has a 9-hole Par-3 course designed by José María Olazábal.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by the legendary José María Olazábal, our 9-hole Par-3 course celebrates the art of control and precision.

verified_facts.text: The golf academy offers one-on-one PGA coaching, a TrackMan simulator and advanced swing analysis.
verified_facts.excerpt: With one-on-one PGA coaching, a TrackMan simulator, and advanced swing analysis, every session brings pro-level focus.

verified_facts.text: The Velaa Spa sits above turquoise waters.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hovering above turquoise waters, our Spa is where time softens.

verified_facts.text: The spa has a snow room experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Maldives’ only snow room experience

verified_facts.text: The spa offers personalised facials and advanced Swiss skin treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Personalised facials and advanced Swiss skin treatments

verified_facts.text: The Velaa Wellbeing Village combines bespoke treatments, movement and mindful dining.
verified_facts.excerpt: Velaa Wellbeing Village is a vast world of care, unlike anything else in the Maldives. Bespoke treatments, thoughtful movement, and mindful dining come together with ease.

verified_facts.text: Eveylaa blends Ayurvedic traditions with modern diagnostics to create a tailored wellbeing plan.
verified_facts.excerpt: By blending Ayurvedic traditions with modern diagnostics, we create a map of your wellbeing. The result is a tailored plan that supports balance while you're here

verified_facts.text: The villas are suspended above the lagoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Suspended above the lagoon, they’re designed for slow mornings with salt on your skin, and golden afternoons spent side by side.

verified_facts.text: Velaa has two-bedroom houses made for shared days with family or friends.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our two-bedroom houses are made for shared days with those closest to you.

verified_facts.text: One of the private residences was designed by Patricia Urquiola.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by Patricia Urquiola

verified_facts.text: One of the private residences was designed by Winch Design.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by Winch Design

verified_facts.text: Homes at Velaa are filled with natural light and ocean views, in colours of sand and sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every home is filled with soft natural light, endless ocean views, and the calming colours of sand and sea.

verified_facts.text: The whole island can be booked as a buyout.
verified_facts.excerpt: For moments that deserve everything, Velaa becomes your own — a private world shared only with those who matter most.

verified_facts.text: Tavaru Tower holds the Maldives' largest private wine cellar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hidden within the Tavaru Tower lies the Maldives’ largest private wine cellar.

verified_facts.text: Tavaru, high above the palms, serves teppanyaki.
verified_facts.excerpt: High above the palms, Tavaru offers a dramatic teppanyaki experience.

verified_facts.text: Aragu blends East and West cooking, with wines and piano music.
verified_facts.excerpt: The inimitable Aragu is where East meets West in a setting of calm sophistication.

verified_facts.text: Each guest has a personal butler.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your personal butler is the guardian of your peace.

verified_facts.text: The Lha Velaa Kids Club offers island quests, crafts and new events.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lha Velaa Kids Club is a joyful mix of island quests, wonderfully messy crafts, and high-spirited fun

verified_facts.text: The kids club team is validated by Worldwide Kids and the Luxury Childcare Association.
verified_facts.excerpt: Validated by Worldwide Kids and the Luxury Childcare Association, our team combines professional expertise with heartfelt, imaginative care.

verified_facts.text: Velaa has a grass tennis court, a squash court and water sports from wakeboarding to kite surfing.
verified_facts.excerpt: a grass tennis court, squash court, and water sports from wakeboarding to kite surfing

verified_facts.text: The resort has its own mini submarine, from which guests can spot sea turtles.
verified_facts.excerpt: which you’ll be able to spot in person from the resort’s own mini submarine

verified_facts.text: Velaa's villas and residences are built of wood and glass and designed to resemble sea turtles, most with pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Czech owners built the resort’s 45 wood-and-glass villas and residences, most with pools, to have plenty of privacy and to resemble sea turtles

verified_facts.text: Velaa is a turtle-shaped island in the Noonu Atoll.
verified_facts.excerpt: The turtle-shaped Velaa Private Island, a speck in the Noonu Atoll

verified_facts.text: The events team plans weddings, proposals, birthdays and private gatherings.
verified_facts.excerpt: A proposal at Velaa is picture-perfect.

verified_facts.text: Faiy, set in tropical gardens, is the restaurant at the centre of the Wellbeing Village.
verified_facts.excerpt: Faiy is the culinary centrepiece of the Village. Nestled within lush tropical gardens
